content.text:
Needed: A case with room for the board and the drives for Custom NAS from spare desktop board
Kind of part: Any item
Top price: 260 USD

request.instructions: You plan a search of second-hand listings for one needed part or device. Write 3 to 6 search phrasings a seller might have put in a listing title: the plain name, synonyms, the part or model number in the ways it gets written, the devices it is sold for, seller wording and common misspellings; each with one line on what it finds that the others miss. A phrasing is a few words for a search box that takes words, not operators or quotes. Then one match pattern: an RE2 regular expression, applied case-insensitively to a listing's text, that a listing which fits the need matches, built from the part number with optional separators or the deciding values with their units. Keep it under 200 characters; use short gaps such as .{0,20} and classes such as [-\s]?; no lookarounds, no backreferences, no comments and no inline flags. Then the words or short phrases in a listing that rule it out: for parts, broken, not working, and any that name a variant that does not fit. Never invent a part or model number the need does not give.

content.text: {"exclusions": ["broken", "cracked", "for parts only", "phone case", "laptop case", "ITX only", "no drive bays"], "pattern": "nas[-\\s]?case|server[-\\s]?case|hot[-\\s]?swap.{0,20}case", "phrasings": [{"text": "NAS case", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=NAS+case", "why": "Finds plain listings titled just NAS case that other wordier searches miss."}, {"text": "server case drive bays", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=server+case+drive+bays", "why": "Finds server and rack cases sold by drive bay count for a desktop board NAS build."}, {"text": "ATX NAS enclosure", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=ATX+NAS+enclosure", "why": "Finds larger enclosures with room for a spare desktop ATX board plus drives."}, {"text": "hot swap hard drive case", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=hot+swap+hard+drive+case", "why": "Finds hot-swap NAS and DAS style cases listed by drive feature not by NAS name."}, {"text": "computer case lots hard drives", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=computer+case+lots+hard+drives", "why": "Finds used PC towers with many 3.5 bays sellers list as drive storage cases."}]}
